📊 Preparing for a SQL Interview? Here's a Visual Shortcut to Your Success! 🔍💼

SQL continues to be one of the most in-demand skills across Data Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Backend Development roles. But what if you had a clean, clear visual to help you review the most frequently asked questions before your next big interview?

That's exactly why I created this SQL Interview Cheatsheet — a visual summary of the 20 most commonly asked SQL questions, split across:

🔹 Basic Concepts – From JOINs, UNION, subqueries, aggregate functions, to primary keys
 🔹 Intermediate to Advanced Topics – Like window functions, CTEs, RANK(), indexing, and query optimization

🎯 Why This Cheatsheet Helps:
✅ Fast recall of important interview concepts
 ✅ Perfect for last-minute revision or daily practice
 ✅ Great tool for both beginners and seasoned professionals

Whether you're actively interviewing or just want to sharpen your SQL chops — this guide will help you focus on what really matters.

Let’s keep building, learning, and landing those dream roles 🚀
